questions_and_answers.question_text: What does dǎ diànhuà mean, and what does dǎ literally mean?
How is verb + general object often translated into English?
Give three other translations for méi guānxi.
What is the literal meaning of méi guānxi?
Write the Chinese for "I called Mrs. Mǎ last night."

answers.answer_text: Wǒ zuótian wǎnshang gěi Mǎ Tàitai dǎle yíge diànhuà.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "It doesn't matter. I know you are very busy."

answers.answer_text: Méi guānxi. Wǒ zhīdao nǐ hěn máng.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Give two other examples of verb + general object.

answers.answer_text: Niàn shū ("to study") and kāi chē ("to drive").

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "I'll be right there after I make a couple of phone calls."

answers.answer_text: Wǒ dǎ liǎngge diànhuà jiù lái.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Which marker shows the ongoing action in wǒ zài kāi huì?

articles.text:
4. B: Duìbuqǐ, jīntian zǎoshang nǐ   I'm sorry. When you called here
      dǎ diànhuà láide shíhou wǒ      this morning, I was in a meeting
      zài kāi huì, méi shíjiān        and didn't have time to speak
      gēn ni shuō huà.                with you.
   A: Méi guānxi. Wǒ zhīdao nǐ hěn   It doesn't matter. I know you are
      máng.                           very busy.

Notes on No. 4

Dǎ diànhuà means "to make a phone call." (Literally, dǎ means "to hit.")

Wǒ zuótian wǎnshang gěi Mǎ       I called Mrs. Mǎ last night.
Tàitai dǎle yíge diànhuà.
Wǒ dǎ liǎngge diànhuà jiù        I'll be right there after I make
lái.                             a couple of phone calls.

Shuō huà, "to speak," is a verb with a general object--literally, "speak words." Verb + general object is often translated into English by a verb alone: niàn shū, "to study"; kāi chē, "to drive."

Méi guānxi: Other translations for this very useful expression are "that's okay," "don't worry about it," "it doesn't make any difference." Literally, méi guānxi would be translated as "there isn't any connection."
